rationale.conceptual: The method is established DFT (GGA-PBE) applied to a specific magnetic material; setting up the three AFM configurations and computing elastic constants requires careful implementation of documented algorithms, but no novel derivation is needed.
rationale.execution: Multi-stage pipeline: setting up and running five magnetic relaxations, followed by strain-based elastic constant calculations and DOS extraction, plus parsing and aggregation; several tool invocations and data handoffs, moderate orchestration complexity.

difficulty.reasoning: Standard DFT calculations with multiple magnetic configurations, elastic constant extraction, and DOS; conceptually non-trivial but well-established, and execution involves orchestrating several QE runs and post-processing, moderate pipeline complexity.

compute_estimate.reasoning: Small unit cell (≈10 atoms) DFT with moderate plane-wave cutoff and k-mesh; runs on CPU with memory ~8 GB; no external datasets.
